name: plateau-conjecture-plans-a-campaign
note: a plateau conjecture needs an algorithm-level experiment, and the plan says so instead of pretending otherwise

input.conjecture: The remaining gap is a tree reduction that a single-work-group algorithm cannot close, so only a multi-stage reduction will reach the bound.
input.expected_observation: attainment clears 80% only after the algorithm changes

conjecture.expected_observation: attainment clears 80% only after the algorithm changes
conjecture.statement: The remaining gap is a tree reduction that a single-work-group algorithm cannot close, so only a multi-stage reduction will reach the bound.

notes: an unverified conjecture may inspire hypotheses and cannot be grounds for verification
keep it in kb/conjectures/ until the plan has run; promotion is a replay-gated move
a plateau conjecture usually needs an algorithm-level experiment, so expect the plan to be a campaign rather than a microbenchmark

cases: the narrowest shape range the conjecture claims
experiments.why_minimal: one campaign experiment on the cheapest dev operator is enough to falsify it

outcome_table.open: the experiment could not be made valid: not_implemented, correctness failed, or the counters were absent
outcome_table.promoted: the observation appears and the metric moves as predicted: attainment clears 80% only after the algorithm changes
outcome_table.refuted: the experiment is valid and the observation does not appear

plan.promotion_path: promotion makes it a candidate rule with this experiment as its single confirmation; it still cannot be used as evidence to verify anything until a second operator confirms it
